  -- Simple JSON array parser for the fleet format:
  -- [ {"name": "Ship Name", "number": 2}, ... ]
  -- Also supports top-level object: {"ships": [...]} or {"fleet": [...]}
  -- Detect if this JSON text is a BattleScribe/NewRecruit roster format.
  -- Rosters contain "roster" at the top level and use "type":"model" for ship entries.
  function isBattleScribeRoster(jsonText)
      -- Quick heuristic: contains the roster wrapper key and model type markers
      return jsonText:find('"roster"', 1, true) ~= nil
          and jsonText:find('"type":"model"', 1, true) ~= nil
  end

  -- Find the matching closing brace/bracket for an opening one.
  -- Returns the index of the closing char, or nil if not found.
  function findMatchingClose(text, openPos)
      local openChar = text:sub(openPos, openPos)
      local closeChar = (openChar == "{") and "}" or "]"
      local depth = 0
      local inString = false
      local escape = false
      for i = openPos, #text do
          local c = text:sub(i, i)
          if escape then
              escape = false
          elseif c == "\\" and inString then
              escape = true
          elseif c == '"' then
              inString = not inString
          elseif not inString then
              if c == openChar then depth = depth + 1
              elseif c == closeChar then
                  depth = depth - 1
                  if depth == 0 then return i end
              end
          end
      end
      return nil
  end

  -- Extract the string value for a given key from a JSON object string.
  -- Only looks at the immediate level (not nested), handles escaped quotes.
function extractJsonString(objStr, key)
    if not objStr or not key then return nil end

    -- Find the opening quote of the VALUE, not just the start of the key.
    local _, valQuoteEnd = objStr:find('"' .. key .. '"%s*:%s*"')
    if not valQuoteEnd then return nil end

    local val = {}
    local i = valQuoteEnd + 1

    while i <= #objStr do
        local c = objStr:sub(i, i)

        if c == "\\" then
            i = i + 1
            if i <= #objStr then
                local escaped = objStr:sub(i, i)

                if escaped == "n" then
                    table.insert(val, "\n")
                elseif escaped == "t" then
                    table.insert(val, "\t")
                elseif escaped == "r" then
                    table.insert(val, "\r")
                else
                    table.insert(val, escaped)
                end
            end
        elseif c == '"' then
            break
        else
            table.insert(val, c)
        end

        i = i + 1
    end

    return table.concat(val)
end

  -- Extract an integer value for a given key from a JSON object string.
  function extractJsonInt(objStr, key)
      local pattern = '"' .. key .. '"%s*:%s*(%d+)'
      local val = objStr:match(pattern)
      return val and tonumber(val) or nil
  end

  -- Parse a BattleScribe/NewRecruit roster JSON and return {name, quantity} list.
  -- Strategy: flat scan the entire JSON for every object that has "type":"model".
  -- Find each such object by scanning forward from every '"type":"model"' hit,
  -- then walk backward to find the opening '{' of that object.
  -- This completely avoids offset arithmetic across substrings.
  function parseBattleScribeRoster(jsonText)
      local results = {}
      local searchStr = '"type":"model"'
      local pos = 1
      local L = #jsonText

      while pos <= L do
          -- Find next occurrence of "type":"model"
          local hitPos = jsonText:find(searchStr, pos, true)
          if not hitPos then break end

          -- Walk backward from hitPos to find the '{' that opened this object.
          -- We need to find the '{' at depth 0 relative to hitPos.
          local objStart = nil
          local depth = 0
          for i = hitPos, 1, -1 do
              local c = jsonText:sub(i, i)
              if c == "}" then
                  depth = depth + 1
              elseif c == "{" then
                  if depth == 0 then
                      objStart = i
                      break
                  else
                      depth = depth - 1
                  end
              end
          end

          if objStart then
              local objEnd = findMatchingClose(jsonText, objStart)
              if objEnd then
                  local objStr = jsonText:sub(objStart, objEnd)
                  -- Double-check this object really has type=model at top level
                  -- (not buried in a nested child). We verify by checking that
                  -- "type":"model" appears before the first nested '{' after objStart.
                  local firstNested = objStr:find("{", 2, true) or (#objStr + 1)
                  local typePos = objStr:find('"type":"model"', 1, true) or (#objStr + 1)
                  -- Also accept if type appears anywhere in this object's flat keys
                  -- (BattleScribe puts type near the top, before selections)
                  local name   = extractJsonString(objStr, "name")
                  local number = extractJsonInt(objStr, "number") or 1
                  if name and trimString(name) ~= "" then
                      if number < 1  then number = 1  end
                      if number > 20 then number = 20 end
                      table.insert(results, {name = trimString(name), quantity = number})
                  end
                  pos = objEnd + 1
              else
                  pos = hitPos + #searchStr
              end
          else
              pos = hitPos + #searchStr
          end
      end

      return results
  end

  -- Parse a simple fleet JSON: [{name="...", number=N}, ...]
  -- Also handles wrapper objects like {"ships": [...]}
  function parseSimpleFleetJSON(jsonText)
      local entries = {}

      -- Unwrap object wrapper if present
      if jsonText:sub(1,1) == "{" then
          local arrStart = jsonText:find("%[")
          local arrEnd   = jsonText:find("%][^%[%]]*$")
          if arrStart and arrEnd then
              jsonText = jsonText:sub(arrStart, arrEnd)
          else
              return entries
          end
      end

      -- Walk objects in the array
      local i = 1
      local L = #jsonText
      while i <= L do
          local objStart = jsonText:find("{", i, true)
          if not objStart then break end

          local objEnd = findMatchingClose(jsonText, objStart)
          if not objEnd then break end

          local objStr = jsonText:sub(objStart, objEnd)

          local nameVal = extractJsonString(objStr, "name")
          local numVal  = extractJsonInt(objStr, "number")
                       or extractJsonInt(objStr, "count")
                       or extractJsonInt(objStr, "qty")
                       or extractJsonInt(objStr, "quantity")
                       or 1

          if nameVal and nameVal ~= "" then
              if numVal < 1  then numVal = 1  end
              if numVal > 20 then numVal = 20 end
              table.insert(entries, {name = trimString(nameVal), quantity = numVal})
          end

          i = objEnd + 1
      end

      return entries
  end

  -- Main entry point: auto-detects format and delegates to the right parser.
  function parseJSONFleet(jsonText)
      if not jsonText or jsonText == "" then return {} end
      jsonText = trimString(jsonText)

      if isBattleScribeRoster(jsonText) then
          return parseBattleScribeRoster(jsonText)
      else
          return parseSimpleFleetJSON(jsonText)
      end
  end

  function parseAndSpawnJSON(jsonText, playerColor)
      local entries = parseJSONFleet(jsonText)

      if #entries == 0 then
          broadcastToColor("No ships found in the JSON. Supports NewRecruit/BattleScribe roster export, or simple format: [{\"name\":\"Ship\",\"number\":2}, ...]", playerColor, {1, 0.5, 0})
          return
      end

      local spawnedCount = 0
      local notFoundList = {}

      for _, entry in ipairs(entries) do
          local shipName = entry.name
          local qty = entry.quantity

          local matchedCards = findMatchingCards(shipName)

          if #matchedCards > 0 then
              local cardIndex = matchedCards[1]
              local indices = {}
              for i = 1, qty do
                  table.insert(indices, cardIndex)
              end
              spawnCardsForPlayer(playerColor, indices)
              spawnedCount = spawnedCount + qty
          else
              table.insert(notFoundList, shipName)
          end
      end

      if spawnedCount > 0 then
          broadcastToColor("Spawned " .. spawnedCount .. " ship card(s) from JSON.", playerColor, {0.2, 1, 0.3})
      end

      if #notFoundList > 0 then
          local notFoundMsg = "Warning: Could not find cards for: "
          for i, name in ipairs(notFoundList) do
              if i > 1 then notFoundMsg = notFoundMsg .. ", " end
              notFoundMsg = notFoundMsg .. name
              if i >= 8 then
                  notFoundMsg = notFoundMsg .. " (and more...)"
                  break
              end
          end
          broadcastToColor(notFoundMsg, playerColor, {1, 1, 0})
      end
  end

  function parseAndSpawnList(listText, playerColor)
      local lines = splitIntoLines(listText)
      local shipEntries = extractShipEntries(lines)

      if #shipEntries == 0 then
          broadcastToColor("No ships found in the list. Make sure the format is correct.", playerColor, {1, 0.5, 0})
          return
      end

      local spawnedCount = 0
      local notFoundList = {}

      -- Spawn ALL ships found (respecting quantities), do not dedupe by name,
      -- because some lists repeat the same ship name at different point costs.
      for _, entry in ipairs(shipEntries) do
          local shipName = entry.name
          local qty = tonumber(entry.quantity) or 1
          if qty < 1 then qty = 1 end
          if qty > 20 then qty = 20 end  -- safety clamp

          local matchedCards = findMatchingCards(shipName)

          if #matchedCards > 0 then
              local cardIndex = matchedCards[1]

              -- Spawn quantity copies (as separate card spawns)
              local indices = {}
              for i = 1, qty do
                  table.insert(indices, cardIndex)
              end
              spawnCardsForPlayer(playerColor, indices)
              spawnedCount = spawnedCount + qty
          else
              table.insert(notFoundList, shipName)
          end
      end

      if spawnedCount > 0 then
          broadcastToColor("Spawned " .. spawnedCount .. " ship card(s) from list.", playerColor, {0.2, 1, 0.3})
      end

      if #notFoundList > 0 then
          local notFoundMsg = "Warning: Could not find cards for: "
          for i, name in ipairs(notFoundList) do
              if i > 1 then notFoundMsg = notFoundMsg .. ", " end
              notFoundMsg = notFoundMsg .. name
              if i >= 8 then
                  notFoundMsg = notFoundMsg .. " (and more...)"
                  break
              end
          end
          broadcastToColor(notFoundMsg, playerColor, {1, 1, 0})
      end
  end

  function splitIntoLines(text)
          local lines = {}
          local currentLine = ""
          for i = 1, #text do
              local char = text:sub(i, i)
              if char == "\n" or char == "\r" then
                  if #currentLine > 0 then
                      table.insert(lines, currentLine)
                      currentLine = ""
                  end
              else
                  currentLine = currentLine .. char
              end
          end
          if #currentLine > 0 then
              table.insert(lines, currentLine)
          end
      return lines
  end

  function removeLineNumber(line)
          local dotPos = findChar(line, ".")
          if dotPos and dotPos < 5 then
              local beforeDot = trimString(line:sub(1, dotPos - 1))
              if isNumeric(beforeDot) then
                  return trimString(line:sub(dotPos + 1))
              end
          end
      return line
  end

 function extractShipEntries(lines)
    local entries = {}

    -- Modes:
    -- "ignore"  : Admirals, Launch Assets — skip
    -- "famous"  : Famous Admirals — only bullet lines that contain a real ship entry
    -- "heavy"   : Colossal/Heavy Groups, Space Stations — treat lines as ships, but still skip headings if next is bullet
    -- "grouped" : Medium/Light/Payload Groups — bullets are ships, headings skipped, non-bullet single-ship lines allowed
    local mode = "ignore"

    for lineIdx, rawLine in ipairs(lines) do
        local line = trimString(rawLine or "")
        if #line > 0 then
            local lowerLine = line:lower()

            -- Section switches (order matters)
            if contains(lowerLine, "famous admirals") then
                mode = "famous"

            elseif contains(lowerLine, "colossal groups")
                or contains(lowerLine, "heavy groups")
                or contains(lowerLine, "space stations") then
                mode = "heavy"

            elseif contains(lowerLine, "medium groups")
                or contains(lowerLine, "light groups")
                or contains(lowerLine, "payload groups") then
                mode = "grouped"

            elseif contains(lowerLine, "admirals")
                or contains(lowerLine, "launch assets") then
                mode = "ignore"

            else
                -- Skip obvious markdown headers and header-like noise lines
                if line:sub(1, 1) ~= "#" and not isHeaderLine(line) then
                    local isBullet = startsWithBullet(line)

                    if mode == "famous" then
                        -- Only accept bullet lines that actually parse into ship entries
                        if isBullet then
                            local extracted = extractInlineShipEntries(line)
                            if extracted and #extracted > 0 then
                                for _, e in ipairs(extracted) do
                                    table.insert(entries, e)
                                end
                            end
                        end

                    elseif mode == "grouped" then
                        local nextIsBullet = nextNonEmptyIsBullet(lines, lineIdx)

                        -- If the next non-empty line is a bullet list and this looks like a heading, skip it
                        if not shouldSkipAsHeading(line, nextIsBullet) then
                            -- If it isn't a bullet and the next isn't a bullet, treat as single-ship line
                            local isSingleShipEntry = (not isBullet) and (not nextIsBullet)

                            if isBullet or isSingleShipEntry then
                                local extracted = extractInlineShipEntries(line)
                                if extracted and #extracted > 0 then
                                    for _, e in ipairs(extracted) do
                                        table.insert(entries, e)
                                    end
                                else
                                    local entry = parseShipLine(line)
                                    if entry then table.insert(entries, entry) end
                                end
                            end
                        end

                    elseif mode == "heavy" then
                        local nextIsBullet = nextNonEmptyIsBullet(lines, lineIdx)

                        -- Same heading-skip rule here, prevents duplicates if heavy sections use headings+bullets
                        if not shouldSkipAsHeading(line, nextIsBullet) then
                            local extracted = extractInlineShipEntries(line)
                            if extracted and #extracted > 0 then
                                for _, e in ipairs(extracted) do
                                    table.insert(entries, e)
                                end
                            else
                                local entry = parseShipLine(line)
                                if entry then table.insert(entries, entry) end
                            end
                        end

                    else
                        -- mode == "ignore": do nothing
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return entries
end



  function isHeaderLine(line)
          if #line == 0 then return true end
          if line:sub(1, 1) == "#" then return true end

      local lowerLine = line:lower()

      if contains(lowerLine, "configuration") or
         contains(lowerLine, "game size") or
         contains(lowerLine, "fleet ++") or
         contains(lowerLine, "famous admirals") then
          return true
      end

      if (contains(lowerLine, "admirals") or contains(lowerLine, "groups")) and
         contains(lowerLine, "[") and contains(lowerLine, "pts]") then
          if not contains(lowerLine, "•") and not contains(line, "x ") then
              return true
          end
      end

      return false
  end

  function parseShipLine(line)
      line = trimString(line)
      if #line == 0 then return nil end

      line = removeLineNumber(line)
      line = trimString(line)

      local colonPos = findChar(line, ":")
      local bulletPresent = startsWithBullet(line)

      if colonPos == #line and not bulletPresent then
          local hasQuantity = false
          for i = 1, 6 do
              if i < #line and line:sub(i, i) == "x" and line:sub(i+1, i+1) == " " then
                  hasQuantity = true
                  break
              end
          end
          if not hasQuantity then
              return nil
          end
      end

      if bulletPresent then
          line = stripBulletPrefix(line)
      end

      local quantity = 1
      local xPos = findChar(line, "x")
      if xPos and xPos < 6 then
          local beforeX = trimString(line:sub(1, xPos - 1))
          if isNumeric(beforeX) then
              quantity = tonumber(beforeX) or 1
              line = trimString(line:sub(xPos + 2))
          end
      end

      local bracketPos = findChar(line, "[")
      colonPos = findChar(line, ":")

      local nameEnd = #line
      if bracketPos and (not colonPos or bracketPos < colonPos) then
          nameEnd = bracketPos - 1
      elseif colonPos then
          nameEnd = colonPos - 1
      end

      local shipName = trimString(line:sub(1, nameEnd))

      if #shipName < 3 then return nil end

      local lowerName = shipName:lower()

      if contains(lowerName, "lvl ") or contains(lowerName, "captain") or contains(lowerName, "admiral") then
          return nil
      end

      if contains(shipName, " - ") and (shipName:sub(-2) == " -" or contains(shipName, "pts]")) then
          return nil
      end

      return {name = shipName, quantity = quantity}
  end

  function findMatchingCards(searchName)
      local matches = {}
      local searchLower = trimString((searchName or ""):lower())
      if searchLower == "" then return matches end

      local searchTokens = tokenizeWords(searchLower)

      local bestScore = -1
      local bestIndex = nil

      for i, card in ipairs(savedShipCards) do
          local cardName = trimString(card.name or "")
          local cardLower = cardName:lower()
          if cardLower ~= "" then
              local score = -1

              if cardLower == searchLower then
                  -- Exact string match is always best
                  score = 100000 + #cardLower
              else
                  local cardTokens = tokenizeWords(cardLower)

                  -- Only allow "token subset" matches where the SEARCH is >= the CARD in specificity.
                  -- This prevents "Cruiser" from matching "Light Cruiser", "Heavy Cruiser", etc.
                  if tokensContainAll(searchTokens, cardTokens) then
                      -- Prefer longer (more specific) card names within this tier
                      score = 50000 + (#cardTokens * 100) + #cardLower
                  end

                  -- Fallback fuzzy contains (lowest priority)
                  if score < 0 then
                      if contains(searchLower, cardLower) or contains(cardLower, searchLower) then
                          score = 1000 + math.min(#cardLower, #searchLower)
                      end
                  end
              end

              if score > bestScore then
                  bestScore = score
                  bestIndex = i
              end
          end
      end

      if bestIndex then
          table.insert(matches, bestIndex)
      end

      return matches
  end
  function trimString(str)
      if not str then return "" end
      local startPos = 1
      while startPos <= #str do
          local char = str:sub(startPos, startPos)
          if char ~= " " and char ~= "\t" and char ~= "\r" and char ~= "\n" then
              break
          end
          startPos = startPos + 1
      end
      local endPos = #str
      while endPos >= 1 do
          local char = str:sub(endPos, endPos)
          if char ~= " " and char ~= "\t" and char ~= "\r" and char ~= "\n" then
              break
          end
          endPos = endPos - 1
      end
      if startPos > endPos then return "" end
      return str:sub(startPos, endPos)
  end

  function findChar(str, char)
      for i = 1, #str do
          if str:sub(i, i) == char then
              return i
          end
      end
      return nil
  end

  function contains(str, substr)
      if not str or not substr then return false end
      if #substr > #str then return false end
      for i = 1, #str - #substr + 1 do
          local match = true
          for j = 1, #substr do
              if str:sub(i + j - 1, i + j - 1) ~= substr:sub(j, j) then
                  match = false
                  break
              end
          end
          if match then return true end
      end
      return false
  end

  function isNumeric(str)
      if not str or #str == 0 then return false end
      for i = 1, #str do
          local char = str:sub(i, i)
          if char < "0" or char > "9" then
              return false
          end
      end
      return true
  end

  -- EMBEDDED DATA (Auto-generated - Do not edit manually)
  --==============================================================================

  --EMBEDDED_DATA_START
  savedShipCards = {
  }

  fresh = true

--==============================================================================

--==============================================================================
--==============================================================================
-- FACTION AUTO-DETECT (from object name)
-- Expected object name format: "Faction ABC" (ABC = 3-letter code)
--==============================================================================


local function asciiLower3(s)
    -- Lowercase A-Z only, safe on any bytes
    if type(s) ~= "string" then return "" end
    return (s:gsub("%u", function(c) return string.char(c:byte() + 32) end))
end

local function detectFactionFromObjectName(obj)
    local name = ""
    if obj and obj.getName then
        local ok, result = pcall(function() return obj.getName() end)
        if ok and type(result) == "string" then name = result end
    end

    -- Extract the 3 letters after "Faction" without calling string.lower on the whole name
    -- Accepts: "Faction PHR", "Faction: PHR", "Faction - PHR"
    local code = name:match("[Ff][Aa][Cc][Tt][Ii][Oo][Nn]%s*[:%-]?%s*(%a%a%a)")
    if not code then return nil end

    code = asciiLower3(code)

    local map = {
        phr = "phr",
        sco = "scourge",
        res = "resistance",
        sha = "shaltari",
        ucm = "ucm",
        bio = "bioficers",
        civ = "civilian",
        ind = "industrial",
    }

    return map[code]
end


-- Decide faction key now
local autoFaction = detectFactionFromObjectName(self) or "civilian"  -- default fallback

CONFIG = {
    -- Faction name (used in broadcasts and UI title)

  --==============================================================================

  --==============================================================================

  function updateSave()
          local script = self.getLuaScript()

          -- Find where the embedded data section starts
          local dataStartPattern = "\n%-%-EMBEDDED_DATA_START"
          local dataStart = script:find(dataStartPattern)

          if dataStart then
              script = script:sub(1, dataStart - 1)
          end

          -- Build the embedded data section
          local embeddedData = "\n--EMBEDDED_DATA_START\n"
          embeddedData = embeddedData .. "savedShipCards = {\n"

          for i, card in ipairs(savedShipCards) do
              embeddedData = embeddedData .. "  {\n"
              embeddedData = embeddedData .. "    name = [====[" .. (card.name or "Unknown") .. "]====],\n"
              embeddedData = embeddedData .. "    imageURL = [====[" .. (card.imageURL or "") .. "]====],\n"
              embeddedData = embeddedData .. "    tonnage = [====[" .. (card.tonnage or "Light") .. "]====],\n"
              embeddedData = embeddedData .. "    shipTonnage = [====[" .. (card.shipTonnage or "Light") .. "]====],\n"
              embeddedData = embeddedData .. "    baseScale = " .. (card.baseScale or 1) .. ",\n"
              if card.json then
                  embeddedData = embeddedData .. "    json = [====[" .. card.json .. "]====],\n"
              end
              embeddedData = embeddedData .. "  },\n"
          end

          embeddedData = embeddedData .. "}\n\n"
          embeddedData = embeddedData .. "fresh = " .. tostring(fresh) .. "\n"

          script = script .. embeddedData
          self.setLuaScript(script)
      end

  function onLoad(saved_data)
          selfGUID = self.getGUID()

          -- Initialize variables if they don't exist
          if savedShipCards == nil then
              savedShipCards = {}
          end
          if fresh == nil then
              fresh = true
          end

          -- Update fresh status based on data
          if #savedShipCards > 0 then
              fresh = false
          end

          -- Initialize player state tables
          playerSelections = {}
          playerCardIndices = {}
          playerSearchFilters = {}
          playerActiveTabs = {}
          playerActiveTonnageTabs = {}
          playerSpawnCounts = {}

          -- Clean loaded data
          for _, card in ipairs(savedShipCards) do
              if card.json then card.json = stripBrackets(card.json) end
              if card.imageURL then card.imageURL = stripBrackets(card.imageURL) end
          end

          -- Ensure all cards have shipTonnage extracted from their JSON
          ensureShipTonnage()

      -- Show appropriate buttons
      if fresh then
          createSetupButton()
      else
          createMainButtonsWithList()
      end
  end

  --==============================================================================
  -- BUTTON CREATION FUNCTIONS
  --==============================================================================

  function createButton_helper(params)
          local defaults = {
              function_owner = self,
              rotation = {0, 0, 0},
              font_color = {1, 1, 1}
          }

          -- Merge params with defaults
          local buttonConfig = {}
          for k, v in pairs(defaults) do
              buttonConfig[k] = v
          end
          for k, v in pairs(params) do
              buttonConfig[k] = v
          end

      self.createButton(buttonConfig)
  end

  function createSetupButton()
          self.clearButtons()
          self.clearInputs()

          createButton_helper({
              label = "Setup",
              click_function = "buttonClick_setup",
              position = {0, 1, 0},
              height = 350,
              width = 800,
              font_size = 250,
          color = {0.2, 0.2, 0.3}
      })
  end

  function createSetupActionButtons()
          self.clearButtons()
          self.clearInputs()

          -- Compact stacked layout (vertical) — smaller buttons
          local btnHeight = 60
          local btnWidth  = 380
          local btnFont   = 60
          local zStart    = 1.2
          local zSpacing  = -0.25

          -- Cancel button (top)
          createButton_helper({
              label = "Cancel",
              click_function = "buttonClick_cancel",
              position = {0, 1, zStart},
              height = btnHeight,
              width = btnWidth,
              font_size = btnFont,
              color = {0.4, 0.2, 0.2}
          })

          -- Add button (below Cancel)
          createButton_helper({
              label = "Add Ships",
              click_function = "buttonClick_add",
              position = {0, 1, zStart + zSpacing},
              height = btnHeight,
              width = btnWidth,
              font_size = btnFont,
              color = {0.2, 0.5, 0.2}
          })

          -- Remove button (only if cards exist)
          if not fresh then
              createButton_helper({
                  label = "Remove Ships",
                  click_function = "buttonClick_remove",
                  position = {0, 1, zStart + (2 * zSpacing)},
                  height = btnHeight,
                  width = btnWidth,
                  font_size = btnFont,
                  color = {0.5, 0.2, 0.2}
              })
          end

          -- Reset button (bottom)
          createButton_helper({
              label = "Reset",
              click_function = "buttonClick_reset",
              position = {0, 1, zStart + (3 * zSpacing)},
              height = btnHeight,
              width = btnWidth,
              font_size = btnFont,
              color = {0.3, 0.3, 0.3}
          })
      end

  --==============================================================================
  -- SETUP MODE FUNCTIONS
  --==============================================================================

  function buttonClick_setup()
          savedShipCardsBackup = duplicateTable(savedShipCards)
      createSetupActionButtons()
      broadcastToAll("Setup Mode: Box-select ship cards, then click Add/Remove", {1, 1, 1})
  end

  function buttonClick_cancel()
          savedShipCards = savedShipCardsBackup

          if #savedShipCards == 0 then
              createSetupButton()
          else
              createMainButtonsWithList()
          end

      broadcastToAll("Setup Canceled", {1, 1, 1})
  end

  function buttonClick_add(obj, player_color)
          local selectedObjs = Player[player_color].getSelectedObjects()
          local count = 0

          for _, selectedObj in ipairs(selectedObjs) do
              if selectedObj and not selectedObj.isDestroyed() and selectedObj ~= self then
                  -- Check if it's a card or tile
                  if selectedObj.tag == "Card" or selectedObj.tag == "Tile" then
                      -- Check if already saved (by name comparison)
                      local cardName = selectedObj.getName()
                      local alreadyExists = false

                      for _, saved in ipairs(savedShipCards) do
                          if saved.name == cardName then
                              alreadyExists = true
                              break
                          end
                      end

                      if not alreadyExists then
                          -- Extract card data
                          local cardData = extractCardData(selectedObj)
                          if cardData then
                              table.insert(savedShipCards, cardData)
                              count = count + 1
                          end
                      end
                  end
              end
          end

          if count > 0 then
              fresh = false
              -- Sort cards alphabetically
              sortShipCards()
              updateSave()
              broadcastToAll(count .. " ship card(s) added to " .. CONFIG.FACTION_NAME .. " Ship Picker", {0.2, 1, 0.2})
          else
              broadcastToAll("No new cards to add (select Card objects)", {1, 0.5, 0.5})
          end

      createMainButtonsWithList()
  end

  function buttonClick_remove(obj, player_color)
          local selectedObjs = Player[player_color].getSelectedObjects()
          local count = 0

          local newSavedCards = {}

          for _, saved in ipairs(savedShipCards) do
              local shouldRemove = false

              for _, selectedObj in ipairs(selectedObjs) do
                  if selectedObj and not selectedObj.isDestroyed() then
                      if selectedObj.getName() == saved.name then
                          shouldRemove = true
                          count = count + 1
                          break
                      end
                  end
              end

              if not shouldRemove then
                  table.insert(newSavedCards, saved)
              end
          end

          savedShipCards = newSavedCards

          if #savedShipCards == 0 then
              fresh = true
              createSetupButton()
          else
              createMainButtonsWithList()
          end

          updateSave()
      broadcastToAll(count .. " ship card(s) removed from " .. CONFIG.FACTION_NAME .. " Ship Picker", {1, 0.5, 0.5})
  end

  function buttonClick_reset()
          fresh = true
          savedShipCards = {}
          savedShipCardsBackup = {}
          playerSelections = {}
          playerSearchFilters = {}
          playerActiveTabs = {}
          playerSpawnCounts = {}

          createSetupButton()
          updateSave()
      broadcastToAll(CONFIG.FACTION_NAME .. " Ship Picker Reset", {1, 1, 1})
  end

  --==============================================================================
  -- CARD DATA EXTRACTION
  --==============================================================================

  function startsWithBullet(line)
      if not line or #line == 0 then return false end
      -- UTF-8 bullet: compare 3-byte sequence
      if #line >= 3 and line:sub(1, 3) == "\xe2\x80\xa2" then return true end
      -- ASCII fallback bullets
      local c = line:sub(1, 1)
      if c == "-" or c == "*" then return true end
      return false
  end

  -- NEW HELPER: Strip bullet prefix and return trimmed remainder
  function stripBulletPrefix(line)
      if #line >= 3 and line:sub(1, 3) == "\xe2\x80\xa2" then
          return trimString(line:sub(4))
      end
      local c = line:sub(1, 1)
      if c == "-" or c == "*" then
          return trimString(line:sub(2))
      end
      return line
  end

  function extractCardData(cardObj)
          if not cardObj then return nil end

          -- Only allow Tile objects
          if cardObj.tag ~= "Tile" then
              broadcastToAll("Ignored object: Only Tile objects can be saved.", {1, 0.5, 0})
              return nil
          end

          local cardData = {
              name = cardObj.getName() or "Unknown Ship",
              json = nil,
              imageURL = "",
              tonnage = "Light",
              baseScale = 1,
          }

          -- Capture the exact JSON of the object (Tile)
          -- We use this exactly as saved for spawning
          cardData.json = cardObj.getJSON()

          -- Extract Image URL for the UI listing (from CustomObject)
          local customObj = cardObj.getCustomObject()
          if customObj and customObj.image then
              cardData.imageURL = customObj.image
          end

          -- Tonnage detection from Description (check for specific ship types)
          local desc = cardObj.getDescription() or ""
          local descLower = string.lower(desc)
          local name = cardObj.getName() or ""
          nameLower = string.lower(name)

          -- Check both description and name for ship type
          local text = descLower .. " " .. nameLower

          -- Ordered from largest to smallest for proper detection
          if string.find(text, "dreadnought") or string.find(text, "dreadnaught") then
              cardData.tonnage = "Dreadnaught"
          elseif string.find(text, "super battleship") or string.find(text, "superbattleship") then
              cardData.tonnage = "Super Battleship"
          elseif string.find(text, "supercarrier") then
              cardData.tonnage = "Supercarrier"
          elseif string.find(text, "battleship") then
              cardData.tonnage = "Battleship"
          elseif string.find(text, "battlecruiser") then
              cardData.tonnage = "Battlecruiser"
          elseif string.find(text, "troopship") then
              cardData.tonnage = "Troopship"
          elseif string.find(text, "heavy cruiser") then
              cardData.tonnage = "Heavy Cruiser"
          elseif string.find(text, "light cruiser") then
              cardData.tonnage = "Light Cruiser"
          elseif string.find(text, "cruiser") then
              cardData.tonnage = "Cruiser"
          elseif string.find(text, "runner") then
              cardData.tonnage = "Runner"
          elseif string.find(text, "destroyer") then
              cardData.tonnage = "Destroyer"
          elseif string.find(text, "cutter") then
              cardData.tonnage = "Cutter"
          elseif string.find(text, "monitor") then
              cardData.tonnage = "Monitor"
          elseif string.find(text, "carrier") then
              cardData.tonnage = "Carrier"
          elseif string.find(text, "frigate") then
              cardData.tonnage = "Frigate"
          elseif string.find(text, "lighter") then
              cardData.tonnage = "Lighter"
          elseif string.find(text, "corvette") then
              cardData.tonnage = "Corvette"
          elseif string.find(text, "cell") then
              cardData.tonnage = "Cell"
          else
              cardData.tonnage = "Other" -- Default for unrecognized types
          end

          -- Attempt to find baseScale in the Lua script for Tonnage Category sorting
          -- (This preserves the existing logic for categorizing ships in the UI)
          local script = cardObj.getLuaScript()
          if script then
              local scale = script:match("baseScale%s*=%s*([%d%.]+)")
              if scale then
                  cardData.baseScale = tonumber(scale)
              end
          end

          -- Extract ShipbaseSize from the card's JSON to determine ship tonnage
          -- ShipbaseSize is embedded in the ship model's LuaScript within the card JSON
          cardData.shipTonnage = extractShipTonnageFromObj(cardObj)

      return cardData
  end

  -- Extracts the ship tonnage (Light/Medium/Heavy/Colossal) from a card object's JSON
  -- by finding the ShipbaseSize variable in the embedded ship model LuaScript
  function extractShipTonnageFromObj(cardObj)
      local jsonStr = cardObj.getJSON()
      if jsonStr then
          return extractShipTonnageFromJSON(jsonStr)
      end
      return "Light" -- Default fallback
  end

  -- Extracts the ship tonnage from a raw JSON string by searching for ShipbaseSize
  function extractShipTonnageFromJSON(jsonStr)
      if not jsonStr then return "Light" end
      local shipbaseSize = jsonStr:match("ShipbaseSize%s*=%s*(%d+)")
      if shipbaseSize then
          local size = tonumber(shipbaseSize)
          if CONFIG.SHIPBASE_TO_TONNAGE[size] then
              return CONFIG.SHIPBASE_TO_TONNAGE[size]
          end
      end
      return "Light" -- Default fallback
  end

  -- Ensures all savedShipCards have shipTonnage set (backward compat for old embedded data)
  function ensureShipTonnage()
      for _, card in ipairs(savedShipCards) do
          if not card.shipTonnage or card.shipTonnage == "" then
              if card.json then
                  card.shipTonnage = extractShipTonnageFromJSON(card.json)
              else
                  card.shipTonnage = "Light"
              end
          end
      end
  end

  function sortShipCards()
          table.sort(savedShipCards, function(a, b)
          return (a.name or "") < (b.name or "")
      end)
  end

  function getFilteredCards(activeTab, activeTonnageTab, searchFilter)
          local filtered = {}
          local searchLower = string.lower(searchFilter or "")

          for i, card in ipairs(savedShipCards) do
              local matchesClassTab = (not activeTab) or (card.tonnage == activeTab)
              local matchesTonnageTab = (not activeTonnageTab) or (card.shipTonnage == activeTonnageTab)
              local matchesSearch = (searchFilter == "") or string.find(string.lower(card.name or ""), searchLower, 1, true)

              if matchesClassTab and matchesTonnageTab and matchesSearch then
                  local cardCopy = duplicateTable(card)
                  cardCopy.originalIndex = i
                  table.insert(filtered, cardCopy)
              end
          end

      return filtered
  end

  function countCardsInCategory(categoryName)
          local count = 0
          for _, card in ipairs(savedShipCards) do
              if card.tonnage == categoryName then
                  count = count + 1
              end
          end
      return count
  end

  function countCardsInTonnage(tonnageName)
          local count = 0
          for _, card in ipairs(savedShipCards) do
              if card.shipTonnage == tonnageName then
                  count = count + 1
              end
          end
      return count
  end

  function escapeXml(str)
          if not str then return "" end
          str = str:gsub("&", "&")
          str = str:gsub("<", "<")
          str = str:gsub(">", ">")
          str = str:gsub('"', """)
          str = str:gsub("'", "'")
      return str
  end

      -- Spawns selected cards for a player at their play area
      function spawnCardsForPlayer(playerColor, cardIndices)
          if not playerSpawnCounts then playerSpawnCounts = {} end

          local spawnConfig = CONFIG.PLAYER_SPAWN_POSITIONS[playerColor]

          if not spawnConfig then
              -- Default spawn position if player color not configured
              spawnConfig = {
                  position = {x = 0, y = 1, z = 0},
                  rotation = {x = 0, y = 0, z = 0},
                  direction = {x = 1, y = 0, z = 0},
              }
              broadcastToColor("Warning: No spawn position configured for " .. playerColor .. ", using center.", playerColor, {1, 1, 0})
          end

          local startPos = spawnConfig.position
          local rotation = spawnConfig.rotation
          local direction = spawnConfig.direction
          local spacing = CONFIG.CARD_SPAWN_SPACING
          local cardsPerRow = CONFIG.CARDS_PER_ROW or 6

          -- Calculate perpendicular "row" direction (rotated 90 degrees on the horizontal plane)
          local rowDirection = {
              x = direction.z,
              y = 0,
              z = direction.x,
          }

          -- Get persistent spawn count for this player
          local currentCount = playerSpawnCounts[playerColor] or 0

          for i, cardIndex in ipairs(cardIndices) do
              local card = savedShipCards[cardIndex]
              if card and card.json then
                  -- Calculate column and row from cumulative count
                  local col = currentCount % cardsPerRow
                  local row = math.floor(currentCount / cardsPerRow)

                  -- Calculate spawn position: col along direction, row along perpendicular
                  local colOffset = col * spacing
                  local rowOffset = row * spacing
                  local spawnPos = {
                      x = startPos.x + (direction.x * colOffset) + (rowDirection.x * rowOffset),
                      y = startPos.y,
                      z = startPos.z + (direction.z * colOffset) + (rowDirection.z * rowOffset),
                  }

                  -- Spawn the card
                  spawnObjectJSON({
                      json = card.json,
                      position = spawnPos,
                      rotation = rotation,
                      sound = true,
                  })

                  -- Increment count for next card
                  currentCount = currentCount + 1
              end
          end

      -- Update persistent count
      playerSpawnCounts[playerColor] = currentCount
  end

  function duplicateTable(oldTable)
          if type(oldTable) ~= "table" then return oldTable end

          local newTable = {}
          for k, v in pairs(oldTable) do
              if type(v) == "table" then
                  newTable[k] = duplicateTable(v)
              else
                  newTable[k] = v
              end
          end
      return newTable
  end

  function round(num, dec)
          local mult = 10 ^ (dec or 0)
      return math.floor(num * mult + 0.5) / mult
  end

  function stripBrackets(str)
          if not str then return "" end
          -- Check for [=[ ... ]=] style first
          local s, e = str:find("^%[=%[.*%]=%]$")
          if s then return str:sub(4, -4) end

          -- Check for [[ ... ]] style
          s, e = str:find("^%[%[.*%]%]$")
          if s then return str:sub(3, -3) end

      return str
  end

	-- Returns true if the next non-empty line after idx begins with a bullet.
	function nextNonEmptyIsBullet(lines, idx)
		if not lines then return false end
		for k = (idx or 0) + 1, #lines do
			local s = trimString(lines[k] or "")
			if #s > 0 then
				return startsWithBullet(s)
			end
		end
		return false
	end

	-- Treat as a "group heading" if the next line is a bullet list.
	-- Typical headings end with ":" and often include "[xx pts]:".
	function shouldSkipAsHeading(line, nextIsBullet)
		if not nextIsBullet then return false end
		if not line or line == "" then return true end
		if startsWithBullet(line) then return false end

		local s = trimString(line)
		local lower = s:lower()

		-- Strong signal: ends with ":" (e.g. "Ifrit Cruisers [85 pts]:")
		if s:sub(-1) == ":" then return true end

		-- Also skip plural “bucket” lines that contain pts but no loadout comma pattern
		-- (keeps single-ship lines like "Hydra Fleet Carrier [135 pts]: Oculus Beams, ...")
		if lower:find("pts]", 1, true) and not lower:find(",", 1, true) then
			return true
		end

		return false
	end

  -- Tokenise a string into lowercase "words" (letters and digits).
  -- Used to prevent ambiguous substring matches like "Cruiser" -> "Light Cruiser".
  function tokenizeWords(str)
      local tokens = {}
      if not str then return tokens end
      str = str:lower()

      local current = ""
      for i = 1, #str do
          local c = str:sub(i, i)
          local isWord = (c >= "a" and c <= "z") or (c >= "0" and c <= "9")
          if isWord then
              current = current .. c
          else
              if #current > 0 then
                  table.insert(tokens, current)
                  current = ""
              end
          end
      end
      if #current > 0 then
          table.insert(tokens, current)
      end
      return tokens
  end

  -- Returns true if all tokens in "needles" appear in "haystack" (as exact tokens).
  function tokensContainAll(haystack, needles)
      if not needles or #needles == 0 then return true end
      if not haystack or #haystack == 0 then return false end

      local set = {}
      for _, t in ipairs(haystack) do
          set[t] = true
      end
      for _, t in ipairs(needles) do
          if not set[t] then
              return false
          end
      end
      return true
  end

  -- Extract ship entries from a single line that may contain multiple "Ship [pts]:" blocks.
  -- Supports optional bullet and quantity like: "• 2x Light Cruiser [96 pts]: ..."
  -- Returns {} if nothing matches.
  function extractInlineShipEntries(line)
      local results = {}
      if not line or line == "" then return results end

      local i = 1
      local L = #line

      while i <= L do
          local openB = string.find(line, "[", i, true)
          if not openB then break end

          local closeB = string.find(line, "]", openB + 1, true)
          if not closeB then break end

          local inside = string.sub(line, openB + 1, closeB - 1)
          if inside and string.find(string.lower(inside), "pts", 1, true) then
              local colon = string.find(line, ":", closeB + 1, true)
              if colon and colon <= closeB + 3 then
                  local j = openB - 1
                  while j > 0 do
                      local ch = string.sub(line, j, j)
                      if ch == "," or ch == ";" then break end
                      j = j - 1
                  end
                  local nameChunk = string.sub(line, j + 1, openB - 1)
                  nameChunk = trimString(nameChunk or "")

                  -- Remove leading bullet if present
                  if startsWithBullet(nameChunk) then
                      nameChunk = stripBulletPrefix(nameChunk)
                  end

                  -- Parse optional quantity like "2x " or "2 x "
                  local qty = 1
                  local k = 1
                  while k <= #nameChunk and string.sub(nameChunk, k, k) == " " do k = k + 1 end

                  local numStart = k
                  while k <= #nameChunk do
                      local c = string.sub(nameChunk, k, k)
                      if c < "0" or c > "9" then break end
                      k = k + 1
                  end
                  local numStr = nil
                  if k > numStart then
                      numStr = string.sub(nameChunk, numStart, k - 1)
                      while k <= #nameChunk and string.sub(nameChunk, k, k) == " " do k = k + 1 end
                      local cx = string.sub(nameChunk, k, k)
                      if cx == "x" or cx == "X" then
                          qty = tonumber(numStr) or 1
                          k = k + 1
                          while k <= #nameChunk and string.sub(nameChunk, k, k) == " " do k = k + 1 end
                          nameChunk = trimString(string.sub(nameChunk, k))
                      end
                  end

                  if nameChunk and #nameChunk >= 3 then
                      table.insert(results, {name = nameChunk, quantity = qty})
                  end

                  i = colon + 1
              else
                  i = closeB + 1
              end
          else
              i = closeB + 1
          end
      end

      return results
  end

  -- Simple JSON array parser for the fleet format:
  -- [ {"name": "Ship Name", "number": 2}, ... ]
  -- Also supports top-level object: {"ships": [...]} or {"fleet": [...]}
  -- Detect if this JSON text is a BattleScribe/NewRecruit roster format.
  -- Rosters contain "roster" at the top level and use "type":"model" for ship entries.
  function isBattleScribeRoster(jsonText)
      -- Quick heuristic: contains the roster wrapper key and model type markers
      return jsonText:find('"roster"', 1, true) ~= nil
          and jsonText:find('"type":"model"', 1, true) ~= nil
  end

  -- Find the matching closing brace/bracket for an opening one.
  -- Returns the index of the closing char, or nil if not found.
  function findMatchingClose(text, openPos)
      local openChar = text:sub(openPos, openPos)
      local closeChar = (openChar == "{") and "}" or "]"
      local depth = 0
      local inString = false
      local escape = false
      for i = openPos, #text do
          local c = text:sub(i, i)
          if escape then
              escape = false
          elseif c == "\\" and inString then
              escape = true
          elseif c == '"' then
              inString = not inString
          elseif not inString then
              if c == openChar then depth = depth + 1
              elseif c == closeChar then
                  depth = depth - 1
                  if depth == 0 then return i end
              end
          end
      end
      return nil
  end

  -- Extract the string value for a given key from a JSON object string.
  -- Only looks at the immediate level (not nested), handles escaped quotes.
function extractJsonString(objStr, key)
    if not objStr or not key then return nil end

    -- Find the opening quote of the VALUE, not just the start of the key.
    local _, valQuoteEnd = objStr:find('"' .. key .. '"%s*:%s*"')
    if not valQuoteEnd then return nil end

    local val = {}
    local i = valQuoteEnd + 1

    while i <= #objStr do
        local c = objStr:sub(i, i)

        if c == "\\" then
            i = i + 1
            if i <= #objStr then
                local escaped = objStr:sub(i, i)

                if escaped == "n" then
                    table.insert(val, "\n")
                elseif escaped == "t" then
                    table.insert(val, "\t")
                elseif escaped == "r" then
                    table.insert(val, "\r")
                else
                    table.insert(val, escaped)
                end
            end
        elseif c == '"' then
            break
        else
            table.insert(val, c)
        end

        i = i + 1
    end

    return table.concat(val)
end

  -- Extract an integer value for a given key from a JSON object string.
  function extractJsonInt(objStr, key)
      local pattern = '"' .. key .. '"%s*:%s*(%d+)'
      local val = objStr:match(pattern)
      return val and tonumber(val) or nil
  end

  -- Parse a BattleScribe/NewRecruit roster JSON and return {name, quantity} list.
  -- Strategy: flat scan the entire JSON for every object that has "type":"model".
  -- Find each such object by scanning forward from every '"type":"model"' hit,
  -- then walk backward to find the opening '{' of that object.
  -- This completely avoids offset arithmetic across substrings.
  function parseBattleScribeRoster(jsonText)
      local results = {}
      local searchStr = '"type":"model"'
      local pos = 1
      local L = #jsonText

      while pos <= L do
          -- Find next occurrence of "type":"model"
          local hitPos = jsonText:find(searchStr, pos, true)
          if not hitPos then break end

          -- Walk backward from hitPos to find the '{' that opened this object.
          -- We need to find the '{' at depth 0 relative to hitPos.
          local objStart = nil
          local depth = 0
          for i = hitPos, 1, -1 do
              local c = jsonText:sub(i, i)
              if c == "}" then
                  depth = depth + 1
              elseif c == "{" then
                  if depth == 0 then
                      objStart = i
                      break
                  else
                      depth = depth - 1
                  end
              end
          end

          if objStart then
              local objEnd = findMatchingClose(jsonText, objStart)
              if objEnd then
                  local objStr = jsonText:sub(objStart, objEnd)
                  -- Double-check this object really has type=model at top level
                  -- (not buried in a nested child). We verify by checking that
                  -- "type":"model" appears before the first nested '{' after objStart.
                  local firstNested = objStr:find("{", 2, true) or (#objStr + 1)
                  local typePos = objStr:find('"type":"model"', 1, true) or (#objStr + 1)
                  -- Also accept if type appears anywhere in this object's flat keys
                  -- (BattleScribe puts type near the top, before selections)
                  local name   = extractJsonString(objStr, "name")
                  local number = extractJsonInt(objStr, "number") or 1
                  if name and trimString(name) ~= "" then
                      if number < 1  then number = 1  end
                      if number > 20 then number = 20 end
                      table.insert(results, {name = trimString(name), quantity = number})
                  end
                  pos = objEnd + 1
              else
                  pos = hitPos + #searchStr
              end
          else
              pos = hitPos + #searchStr
          end
      end

      return results
  end

  -- Parse a simple fleet JSON: [{name="...", number=N}, ...]
  -- Also handles wrapper objects like {"ships": [...]}
  function parseSimpleFleetJSON(jsonText)
      local entries = {}

      -- Unwrap object wrapper if present
      if jsonText:sub(1,1) == "{" then
          local arrStart = jsonText:find("%[")
          local arrEnd   = jsonText:find("%][^%[%]]*$")
          if arrStart and arrEnd then
              jsonText = jsonText:sub(arrStart, arrEnd)
          else
              return entries
          end
      end

      -- Walk objects in the array
      local i = 1
      local L = #jsonText
      while i <= L do
          local objStart = jsonText:find("{", i, true)
          if not objStart then break end

          local objEnd = findMatchingClose(jsonText, objStart)
          if not objEnd then break end

          local objStr = jsonText:sub(objStart, objEnd)

          local nameVal = extractJsonString(objStr, "name")
          local numVal  = extractJsonInt(objStr, "number")
                       or extractJsonInt(objStr, "count")
                       or extractJsonInt(objStr, "qty")
                       or extractJsonInt(objStr, "quantity")
                       or 1

          if nameVal and nameVal ~= "" then
              if numVal < 1  then numVal = 1  end
              if numVal > 20 then numVal = 20 end
              table.insert(entries, {name = trimString(nameVal), quantity = numVal})
          end

          i = objEnd + 1
      end

      return entries
  end

  -- Main entry point: auto-detects format and delegates to the right parser.
  function parseJSONFleet(jsonText)
      if not jsonText or jsonText == "" then return {} end
      jsonText = trimString(jsonText)

      if isBattleScribeRoster(jsonText) then
          return parseBattleScribeRoster(jsonText)
      else
          return parseSimpleFleetJSON(jsonText)
      end
  end

  function parseAndSpawnJSON(jsonText, playerColor)
      local entries = parseJSONFleet(jsonText)

      if #entries == 0 then
          broadcastToColor("No ships found in the JSON. Supports NewRecruit/BattleScribe roster export, or simple format: [{\"name\":\"Ship\",\"number\":2}, ...]", playerColor, {1, 0.5, 0})
          return
      end

      local spawnedCount = 0
      local notFoundList = {}

      for _, entry in ipairs(entries) do
          local shipName = entry.name
          local qty = entry.quantity

          local matchedCards = findMatchingCards(shipName)

          if #matchedCards > 0 then
              local cardIndex = matchedCards[1]
              local indices = {}
              for i = 1, qty do
                  table.insert(indices, cardIndex)
              end
              spawnCardsForPlayer(playerColor, indices)
              spawnedCount = spawnedCount + qty
          else
              table.insert(notFoundList, shipName)
          end
      end

      if spawnedCount > 0 then
          broadcastToColor("Spawned " .. spawnedCount .. " ship card(s) from JSON.", playerColor, {0.2, 1, 0.3})
      end

      if #notFoundList > 0 then
          local notFoundMsg = "Warning: Could not find cards for: "
          for i, name in ipairs(notFoundList) do
              if i > 1 then notFoundMsg = notFoundMsg .. ", " end
              notFoundMsg = notFoundMsg .. name
              if i >= 8 then
                  notFoundMsg = notFoundMsg .. " (and more...)"
                  break
              end
          end
          broadcastToColor(notFoundMsg, playerColor, {1, 1, 0})
      end
  end

  function parseAndSpawnList(listText, playerColor)
      local lines = splitIntoLines(listText)
      local shipEntries = extractShipEntries(lines)

      if #shipEntries == 0 then
          broadcastToColor("No ships found in the list. Make sure the format is correct.", playerColor, {1, 0.5, 0})
          return
      end

      local spawnedCount = 0
      local notFoundList = {}

      -- Spawn ALL ships found (respecting quantities), do not dedupe by name,
      -- because some lists repeat the same ship name at different point costs.
      for _, entry in ipairs(shipEntries) do
          local shipName = entry.name
          local qty = tonumber(entry.quantity) or 1
          if qty < 1 then qty = 1 end
          if qty > 20 then qty = 20 end  -- safety clamp

          local matchedCards = findMatchingCards(shipName)

          if #matchedCards > 0 then
              local cardIndex = matchedCards[1]

              -- Spawn quantity copies (as separate card spawns)
              local indices = {}
              for i = 1, qty do
                  table.insert(indices, cardIndex)
              end
              spawnCardsForPlayer(playerColor, indices)
              spawnedCount = spawnedCount + qty
          else
              table.insert(notFoundList, shipName)
          end
      end

      if spawnedCount > 0 then
          broadcastToColor("Spawned " .. spawnedCount .. " ship card(s) from list.", playerColor, {0.2, 1, 0.3})
      end

      if #notFoundList > 0 then
          local notFoundMsg = "Warning: Could not find cards for: "
          for i, name in ipairs(notFoundList) do
              if i > 1 then notFoundMsg = notFoundMsg .. ", " end
              notFoundMsg = notFoundMsg .. name
              if i >= 8 then
                  notFoundMsg = notFoundMsg .. " (and more...)"
                  break
              end
          end
          broadcastToColor(notFoundMsg, playerColor, {1, 1, 0})
      end
  end

  function splitIntoLines(text)
          local lines = {}
          local currentLine = ""
          for i = 1, #text do
              local char = text:sub(i, i)
              if char == "\n" or char == "\r" then
                  if #currentLine > 0 then
                      table.insert(lines, currentLine)
                      currentLine = ""
                  end
              else
                  currentLine = currentLine .. char
              end
          end
          if #currentLine > 0 then
              table.insert(lines, currentLine)
          end
      return lines
  end

  function removeLineNumber(line)
          local dotPos = findChar(line, ".")
          if dotPos and dotPos < 5 then
              local beforeDot = trimString(line:sub(1, dotPos - 1))
              if isNumeric(beforeDot) then
                  return trimString(line:sub(dotPos + 1))
              end
          end
      return line
  end

 function extractShipEntries(lines)
    local entries = {}

    -- Modes:
    -- "ignore"  : Admirals, Launch Assets — skip
    -- "famous"  : Famous Admirals — only bullet lines that contain a real ship entry
    -- "heavy"   : Colossal/Heavy Groups, Space Stations — treat lines as ships, but still skip headings if next is bullet
    -- "grouped" : Medium/Light/Payload Groups — bullets are ships, headings skipped, non-bullet single-ship lines allowed
    local mode = "ignore"

    for lineIdx, rawLine in ipairs(lines) do
        local line = trimString(rawLine or "")
        if #line > 0 then
            local lowerLine = line:lower()

            -- Section switches (order matters)
            if contains(lowerLine, "famous admirals") then
                mode = "famous"

            elseif contains(lowerLine, "colossal groups")
                or contains(lowerLine, "heavy groups")
                or contains(lowerLine, "space stations") then
                mode = "heavy"

            elseif contains(lowerLine, "medium groups")
                or contains(lowerLine, "light groups")
                or contains(lowerLine, "payload groups") then
                mode = "grouped"

            elseif contains(lowerLine, "admirals")
                or contains(lowerLine, "launch assets") then
                mode = "ignore"

            else
                -- Skip obvious markdown headers and header-like noise lines
                if line:sub(1, 1) ~= "#" and not isHeaderLine(line) then
                    local isBullet = startsWithBullet(line)

                    if mode == "famous" then
                        -- Only accept bullet lines that actually parse into ship entries
                        if isBullet then
                            local extracted = extractInlineShipEntries(line)
                            if extracted and #extracted > 0 then
                                for _, e in ipairs(extracted) do
                                    table.insert(entries, e)
                                end
                            end
                        end

                    elseif mode == "grouped" then
                        local nextIsBullet = nextNonEmptyIsBullet(lines, lineIdx)

                        -- If the next non-empty line is a bullet list and this looks like a heading, skip it
                        if not shouldSkipAsHeading(line, nextIsBullet) then
                            -- If it isn't a bullet and the next isn't a bullet, treat as single-ship line
                            local isSingleShipEntry = (not isBullet) and (not nextIsBullet)

                            if isBullet or isSingleShipEntry then
                                local extracted = extractInlineShipEntries(line)
                                if extracted and #extracted > 0 then
                                    for _, e in ipairs(extracted) do
                                        table.insert(entries, e)
                                    end
                                else
                                    local entry = parseShipLine(line)
                                    if entry then table.insert(entries, entry) end
                                end
                            end
                        end

                    elseif mode == "heavy" then
                        local nextIsBullet = nextNonEmptyIsBullet(lines, lineIdx)

                        -- Same heading-skip rule here, prevents duplicates if heavy sections use headings+bullets
                        if not shouldSkipAsHeading(line, nextIsBullet) then
                            local extracted = extractInlineShipEntries(line)
                            if extracted and #extracted > 0 then
                                for _, e in ipairs(extracted) do
                                    table.insert(entries, e)
                                end
                            else
                                local entry = parseShipLine(line)
                                if entry then table.insert(entries, entry) end
                            end
                        end

                    else
                        -- mode == "ignore": do nothing
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return entries
end



  function isHeaderLine(line)
          if #line == 0 then return true end
          if line:sub(1, 1) == "#" then return true end

      local lowerLine = line:lower()

      if contains(lowerLine, "configuration") or
         contains(lowerLine, "game size") or
         contains(lowerLine, "fleet ++") or
         contains(lowerLine, "famous admirals") then
          return true
      end

      if (contains(lowerLine, "admirals") or contains(lowerLine, "groups")) and
         contains(lowerLine, "[") and contains(lowerLine, "pts]") then
          if not contains(lowerLine, "•") and not contains(line, "x ") then
              return true
          end
      end

      return false
  end

  function parseShipLine(line)
      line = trimString(line)
      if #line == 0 then return nil end

      line = removeLineNumber(line)
      line = trimString(line)

      local colonPos = findChar(line, ":")
      local bulletPresent = startsWithBullet(line)

      if colonPos == #line and not bulletPresent then
          local hasQuantity = false
          for i = 1, 6 do
              if i < #line and line:sub(i, i) == "x" and line:sub(i+1, i+1) == " " then
                  hasQuantity = true
                  break
              end
          end
          if not hasQuantity then
              return nil
          end
      end

      if bulletPresent then
          line = stripBulletPrefix(line)
      end

      local quantity = 1
      local xPos = findChar(line, "x")
      if xPos and xPos < 6 then
          local beforeX = trimString(line:sub(1, xPos - 1))
          if isNumeric(beforeX) then
              quantity = tonumber(beforeX) or 1
              line = trimString(line:sub(xPos + 2))
          end
      end

      local bracketPos = findChar(line, "[")
      colonPos = findChar(line, ":")

      local nameEnd = #line
      if bracketPos and (not colonPos or bracketPos < colonPos) then
          nameEnd = bracketPos - 1
      elseif colonPos then
          nameEnd = colonPos - 1
      end

      local shipName = trimString(line:sub(1, nameEnd))

      if #shipName < 3 then return nil end

      local lowerName = shipName:lower()

      if contains(lowerName, "lvl ") or contains(lowerName, "captain") or contains(lowerName, "admiral") then
          return nil
      end

      if contains(shipName, " - ") and (shipName:sub(-2) == " -" or contains(shipName, "pts]")) then
          return nil
      end

      return {name = shipName, quantity = quantity}
  end

  function findMatchingCards(searchName)
      local matches = {}
      local searchLower = trimString((searchName or ""):lower())
      if searchLower == "" then return matches end

      local searchTokens = tokenizeWords(searchLower)

      local bestScore = -1
      local bestIndex = nil

      for i, card in ipairs(savedShipCards) do
          local cardName = trimString(card.name or "")
          local cardLower = cardName:lower()
          if cardLower ~= "" then
              local score = -1

              if cardLower == searchLower then
                  -- Exact string match is always best
                  score = 100000 + #cardLower
              else
                  local cardTokens = tokenizeWords(cardLower)

                  -- Only allow "token subset" matches where the SEARCH is >= the CARD in specificity.
                  -- This prevents "Cruiser" from matching "Light Cruiser", "Heavy Cruiser", etc.
                  if tokensContainAll(searchTokens, cardTokens) then
                      -- Prefer longer (more specific) card names within this tier
                      score = 50000 + (#cardTokens * 100) + #cardLower
                  end

                  -- Fallback fuzzy contains (lowest priority)
                  if score < 0 then
                      if contains(searchLower, cardLower) or contains(cardLower, searchLower) then
                          score = 1000 + math.min(#cardLower, #searchLower)
                      end
                  end
              end

              if score > bestScore then
                  bestScore = score
                  bestIndex = i
              end
          end
      end

      if bestIndex then
          table.insert(matches, bestIndex)
      end

      return matches
  end
  function trimString(str)
      if not str then return "" end
      local startPos = 1
      while startPos <= #str do
          local char = str:sub(startPos, startPos)
          if char ~= " " and char ~= "\t" and char ~= "\r" and char ~= "\n" then
              break
          end
          startPos = startPos + 1
      end
      local endPos = #str
      while endPos >= 1 do
          local char = str:sub(endPos, endPos)
          if char ~= " " and char ~= "\t" and char ~= "\r" and char ~= "\n" then
              break
          end
          endPos = endPos - 1
      end
      if startPos > endPos then return "" end
      return str:sub(startPos, endPos)
  end

  function findChar(str, char)
      for i = 1, #str do
          if str:sub(i, i) == char then
              return i
          end
      end
      return nil
  end

  function contains(str, substr)
      if not str or not substr then return false end
      if #substr > #str then return false end
      for i = 1, #str - #substr + 1 do
          local match = true
          for j = 1, #substr do
              if str:sub(i + j - 1, i + j - 1) ~= substr:sub(j, j) then
                  match = false
                  break
              end
          end
          if match then return true end
      end
      return false
  end

  function isNumeric(str)
      if not str or #str == 0 then return false end
      for i = 1, #str do
          local char = str:sub(i, i)
          if char < "0" or char > "9" then
              return false
          end
      end
      return true
  end

  }

--==============================================================================

--==============================================================================
--==============================================================================
-- FACTION AUTO-DETECT (from object name)
-- Expected object name format: "Faction ABC" (ABC = 3-letter code)
--==============================================================================


local function asciiLower3(s)
    -- Lowercase A-Z only, safe on any bytes
    if type(s) ~= "string" then return "" end
    return (s:gsub("%u", function(c) return string.char(c:byte() + 32) end))
end

local function detectFactionFromObjectName(obj)
    local name = ""
    if obj and obj.getName then
        local ok, result = pcall(function() return obj.getName() end)
        if ok and type(result) == "string" then name = result end
    end

    -- Extract the 3 letters after "Faction" without calling string.lower on the whole name
    -- Accepts: "Faction PHR", "Faction: PHR", "Faction - PHR"
    local code = name:match("[Ff][Aa][Cc][Tt][Ii][Oo][Nn]%s*[:%-]?%s*(%a%a%a)")
    if not code then return nil end

    code = asciiLower3(code)

    local map = {
        phr = "phr",
        sco = "scourge",
        res = "resistance",
        sha = "shaltari",
        ucm = "ucm",
        bio = "bioficers",
        civ = "civilian",
        ind = "industrial",
    }

    return map[code]
end


-- Decide faction key now
local autoFaction = detectFactionFromObjectName(self) or "civilian"  -- default fallback

CONFIG = {

          -- Element size controls

  --==============================================================================
  -- STATE VARIABLES
  --==============================================================================

  savedShipCards = {}
  savedShipCardsBackup = {}
  playerSelections = {}
  playerCardIndices = {}

  playerActiveTabs = {}
